svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make three. Exterior plywood 25 mm, 1,500 x 1,220 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cleats: two hardwood 45 x 45 x 1,400 mm battens glued and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screwed underneath, 250 mm each side of the middle, running

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: along the 1,500 mm length, 50 mm in from each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The cleats drop between the runners so the panel cannot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal all edges; grit paint on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the panel drops onto three runners 500 mm apart and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sits flat; it weighs no more than 35 kg.
